headline: Wall Street Advances Led by Gains in AI and Tech Shares
summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 360.21 points to 52,856.09, while the Nasdaq led Wall Street gains supported by artificial intelligence sentiment and earnings strength.
why: Major US equity indexes reflect global risk appetite and investor sentiment regarding corporate profitability in the technology sector.
why_moved: Strong earnings from tech and AI infrastructure providers boosted investor sentiment across equity markets.
